When a man dies, do not defile yourself for him; nor shall you make any cuts in your flesh; for I am the Lord your God.
"The land shall not be defiled, nor shall it be filled with uncleanness; do not let your daughter become a harlot, lest the land fall into harlotry."
Keep my Sabbaths; and reverence my sanctuary; for I am the Lord your God.
"And do not go after the diviners and the sorcerers; do not seek them, lest you be defiled by them; for I am the Lord your God."
"Rise before the gray-headed, and honor the presence of an old man; and fear your God: I am the Lord your God."
"If a stranger dwells with you in your land, you shall not mistreat him."
"You shall treat the stranger who sojourns among you as the native among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God."
"You shall not do injustice in judgment, in measurement of length, weight, or volume."
"You shall have honest scales, honest weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt."
"You shall observe all my statutes and all my judgments, and do them: I am the Lord your God."

sections.title: The Penalty for Transgressing the Law

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:

"Moreover, thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Any man of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech, he shall surely be put to death; the people of the land shall stone him with stones."
"And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name."

"And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not: then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a-whoring after him, from among their people."
"And I will set my face against those that turn unto familiar spirits, and against the wizards, and I will cut them off from among their people."
"And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people."
"Thus shall ye be holy; for I the Lord your God am holy."
"Ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the Lord which sanctify you."
"For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him."
"And the man that taketh his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing; he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless."
If any man lies with his father's wife, he has uncovered his father's nakedness; both of them shall surely be put to death; they are guilty of a crime.
If any man lies with his mother-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death; they have committed a detestable act; they are guilty of a crime.
If any man lies with a woman as he lies with a man, both of them have committed a detestable act; they shall surely be put to death; they are guilty of a crime.
If any man has relations with his mother and his daughter, it is a sin; let him be consumed by fire, lest sin be among them.
If any man has relations with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal as well.
Any woman who approaches an animal to mate with it, and any man who lies with an animal, both the woman and the animal shall surely be put to death; they are guilty of a crime.

"If any man lies with his father's daughter or his mother's daughter, or his sister, and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, this is a detestable act; they shall surely be put to death in the presence of their people; he has uncovered his sister's nakedness and shall bear his iniquity."
If any man lies with a woman who is a slave and uncovers her nakedness, and she uncovers his blood, both of them shall be cast out from among their people.
You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister or your mother's sister; whoever does this has uncovered their relative's nakedness; they shall bear their iniquity.
If a man lies with a close relative's wife, he has uncovered his relative's nakedness; they shall surely be put to death; without children they shall die.
If a man takes his brother's wife, it is a wickedness; he has uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
"Therefore, you shall keep all My statutes and all My judgments, and perform them, lest the land where I bring you to dwell spew you out."
"Do not walk in the customs of the people whom I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them."
"But as for you, you shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess, a land flowing with milk and honey; I am the Lord your God, who has separated you from the peoples."

"And you shall make a distinction between the clean animals and the unclean, and between the unclean birds and the clean; and you shall not bring abomination upon yourselves by beast or by bird or by any living thing that creeps on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean."
"For I am the Lord your God; you shall therefore consecrate yourselves, and you shall be holy; for I am holy. I have separated you from the peoples, that you should be Mine."
"If a man or a woman has a medium or who is a spiritist, they shall surely be put to death; they shall stone them with stones; their blood shall be upon them."

sections.title: Concerning the sanctity of the priests.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው፥ “ከወገናቸው በሞተ ሰው ራሳቸውን እንዳያረክሱ ለካህናቱ ለአሮን ልጆች ንገራቸው።
ከቅርብ ዘመዶቻቸው፥ ከአባቶቻቸው፥ ወይም ከእናቶቻቸው፥ ወይም ከወንዶች ልጆቻቸው፥ ወይም ከሴቶች ልጆቻቸው፥ ወይም ከወንድሞቻቸው፥
ወይም ከቀረበች ያላገባች ድንግል እኅት በቀር ራሳቸውን አያርክሱ።
ራሱን ያጐሰቍል ዘንድ ከሕዝቡ በማንም አይርከስ።
ስለ ሞተው ሰው ራሳቸውን አይላጩ፤ ጢማቸውንም አይላጩ፤ ሥጋቸውንም አይንጩ።
ለአምላካቸው ቅዱሳን ይሁኑ፤ የአምላካቸውንም ስም አያርክሱ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን መሥዋዕትና የአምላካቸውን መባ ያቀርባሉና ቅዱሳን ይሁኑ።
ለአምላኩ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ነውና ጋለሞታን ሴት ወይም የረከሰችውን አያግባ፤ ወይም ከባልዋ የተፋታችውን አያግባ።
የአምላክህን መባ ያቀርባልና ስለዚህ ትቀድሰዋለህ፤ እኔም የምቀድሳችሁ እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ነኝና እርሱ ቅዱስ ይሁንልህ።
የካህንም ሰው ልጅ በግልሙትና ራስዋን ብታረክስ በግልሙትና አባቷን ታረክሰዋለች፤ በእሳት ትቃጠል።
“በራሱም ላይ የቅባት ዘይት የፈሰሰበት፥ የክህነትም ልብስ ይለብስ ዘንድ የተቀደሰ፥ ከወንድሞቹ የተለየው ካህን ራሱን አይላጭ፤ ልብሱንም አይቅደድ።
And let no man who is dead be accepted; neither shall he be defiled by his father or by his mother.
For the offering of the Lord is holy, and it shall not go out from the sanctuary; neither shall he profane the holy name of his God; I am the Lord.
And he shall take a woman of his kindred, a virgin.
He shall not take a widow, nor one who is put away, nor one who is defiled; but he shall take a virgin of his own people.
For I am the Lord your God, and I will not defile my sanctuary among the people.
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"Speak unto Aaron, saying, 'There shall not be any man among your descendants who is unclean in his generations, to offer the bread of his God.'
No man who is unclean shall offer; whether he be blind, or lame, or has a flat nose, or any blemish,
Or a man who has a broken foot, or a broken hand,
Or a hunchback, or a dwarf, or that has a blemish in his eye, or is scabbed, or has a sore, or has a broken testicle; no man who has any blemish shall come near to offer the offerings of the Lord.
A man who is of the lineage of Aaron the priest shall not offer the offerings of the Lord; he is unclean; he shall not offer the bread of his God.
Let him eat the holy things and the holy offerings of his God.
Nevertheless, since he is unclean, let him not enter the sanctuaries, nor approach the altar; for I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
And Moses spoke this to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

sections.title: The holiness of the sacrifice.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
"The children of Israel shall separate themselves from the holy things which they dedicate unto Me, and they shall not profane My holy name; I am the Lord."

Thus He spoke unto them: "Any man of your seed throughout your generations who is unclean by reason of a bodily issue, if he come near unto the holy things which the children of Israel offer unto the Lord, that soul shall be cut off from My presence; I am the Lord."

"And of the seed of Aaron, if he be a leper or have a running issue, until he be clean, he shall not eat of the holy things which are of the offerings of the Lord made by fire; and if he touch the uncleanness of a dead body, or if he be defiled by any unclean thing,"
"or if he touch any creeping thing whereby he may be made unclean, or if he touch any man by whom he may be made unclean,"
"the soul that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening; and shall not eat of the holy things unless he wash his flesh with water."
"And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and afterward he may eat of the holy things; for it is his food."
"And he shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the Lord; and he shall not eat the dead body or the broken limb; for I am the Lord."
"If he profane them, he shall die; and he shall not bear sin for her, nor for the sin of her people; but he shall keep My laws; for I am the Lord."
"A stranger shall not eat of the holy things; a sojourner of the priest shall not eat of the holy things."
But if the priest buys a servant with his money, he shall eat of the food; and those born in his house shall eat of his bread.
And if the son of the priest should marry a woman of another lineage, she shall not eat of the holy things, even though she is consecrated.

However, if the son of the priest's wife dies, or if she is divorced, and she has no children, and she returns to her father's house, she shall eat of her father's bread; but a man of another lineage shall not eat of it.
Any man who unknowingly eats of the holy thing shall add a fifth part to it and give it to the priest.
And concerning those things that are offered to the Lord, do not profane the holy things among the children of Israel.
While they are in sin, if they eat of the holy offerings, sin and iniquity shall be upon them; for I am the Lord your God who sanctifies them.”
And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
“Speak to Aaron and his sons, and to all the children of Israel, saying: Any man of the house of Israel or of your strangers who dwells among you, who offers his sacrifice to the Lord,
shall bring it from the herd, or from the flock, or from the goats, without blemish.
But you shall not offer to the Lord anything that has a blemish, for it shall not be accepted on your behalf.”

Whatever man may offer as a sacrifice, whether for the fulfillment of his vow or for the offering of his freewill, whether it be a peace offering, or a bull, or a sheep, let it be perfect; there shall be no blemish in it.

A blind animal, or one that is broken, or one that has a mutilated member, or one that is scabbed, or one that is diseased, do not offer these to the Lord your God; nor shall you make any such offerings as a burnt offering to the Lord your God.
If your bull, or your sheep, or your goat has a broken limb, do not offer it; rather, take your own money and make an offering, for it shall not be accepted as a sacrifice.
Do not offer to the Lord your God any animal that is bruised, or broken, or maimed, or that has a blemish; nor shall you do any such thing in your land.
And if there be a man among you who is of a foreign lineage, do not offer his hand to your God; for he is unclean, and he shall not be accepted by you.
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
"If a lamb, or a goat, or a kid be born, let it remain with its mother for seven days; and on the eighth day, let it be offered as a burnt offering to the Lord."
If it be a lamb, or a goat, or a kid, do not sacrifice them and their offspring on the same day.
And when you offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving to the Lord, offer them in such a manner that they may be accepted by you.
On that day, it shall be said: "Do not leave anything of it until the morning; for I am the Lord your God."
ትእዛዛቴን ጠብቁ፤ አድርጉትም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝና።
የተቀደሰውንም ስሜን አታርክሱ፤ እኔ ግን በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል እቀደሳለሁ፤
የምቀድሳችሁ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝና። አምላካችሁም እሆን ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝና።”

sections.title: The Festivals of Faith

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, 'These are the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations; even these are My feasts.'"

"Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work; but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, a holy convocation to the Lord; thou shalt do no work therein; it is the sabbath of the Lord in all your dwellings."
"These are the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons; they are holy convocations."

sections.title: In the feast of Passover and in the feast of Unleavened Bread.

verses.text: "In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the Passover of the Lord."
"And in this month, on the fifteenth day, is the Feast of Unleavened Bread to the Lord; seven days you shall eat unleavened bread."
"The first day shall be a holy assembly for you; you shall do no work of any kind."
"And on the seventh day, you shall present an offering made by fire to the Lord; the seventh day shall be a holy assembly for you; you shall do no work of any kind."
"And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,"
"Speak to the children of Israel, saying: When you come into the land which I give to you, and reap its harvest, then you shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest."
"And he shall wave the sheaf before the Lord, to be accepted on your behalf; on the day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it."
"And on the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb of the first year without blemish as a burnt offering to the Lord."

"And the grain offering shall be two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the Lord for a sweet aroma; and the drink offering shall be of wine, one-fourth of a hin."

"And you shall eat neither bread nor roasted grain nor fresh grain until this same day, until you have brought an offering to your God. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings."

sections.title: In the world of the spirit.

verses.text: "You shall count seven complete weeks from the day you bring the sheaf of the wave offering, after the Sabbath."
"Count fifty days to the end of the seventh week, and bring a new grain offering to the Lord."

"From your dwelling place, if there be two hands of fine flour made from good wheat, you shall bring two loaves of bread for the offering; and from your first fruits, let them be offered to the Lord."

"With the lambs that have no blemish, you shall offer seven lambs of the first year, and from the herd, one bullock and two rams without blemish; and let their offerings and sacrifices be acceptable to the Lord."
"One unblemished goat for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a peace offering, you shall offer with the first of your grain offerings for safety."
"The priest shall offer it before the Lord with the two lambs; for it is a holy offering to the Lord; let it be for the priest who offers it."
"This day shall be a holy assembly for you; you shall do no work; it is a statute forever in all your dwellings for your generations."

"When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, nor shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest; you shall leave them for the poor and for the stranger; I am the Lord your God."

sections.title: In the world of creation.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel: In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, shall be a sabbath of rest, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation unto you."
"Ye shall do no manner of work therein; but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord."

sections.title: The Day of Atonement

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,

“In this seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, it shall be a day of atonement for you; it shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall afflict your souls, and you shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
For you shall have a day of atonement before your God; it is a day of atonement, and on that day you shall do no work.
And on that day, any person who does not afflict his soul shall be cut off from among his people.
And any person who does any work on that day shall be cut off from among his people.
You shall do no work at all; it is a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
It shall be a Sabbath of rest for you, and you shall afflict your souls; from the evening of the ninth day of the month until the evening of the tenth day, you shall celebrate your Sabbath.”

sections.title: The Feast of the Dedication

verses.text: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው፦ በዚህ በሰባተኛው ወር ከዐሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን ጀምሮ ሰባት ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር የዳስ በዓል ይሆናል።
የመጀመሪያዋ ቀን ቅድስት ጉባኤ ትሁንላችሁ፤ የተግባር ሥራ ሁሉ አታድርጉባት።
ሰባት ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አቅርቡ፤ ስምንተኛዋም ቀን የተቀደሰች ጉባኤ ትሁንላችሁ፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አቅርቡ፤ የመሰናበቻ በዓል ነውና፤ የተግባር ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት።
“የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ የእህሉንም ቍርባን፥ መሥዋዕቱንም፥ የመጠጡንም ቍርባን፥ በየቀኑ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር ታቀርቡባቸው ዘንድ የተቀደሱ በዓላት እንዲሆኑ የምታውጁአቸው የእግዚአብሔር በዓላት እነዚህ ናቸው።
እነዚህም ከእግዚአብሔር ሰንበታት ሌላ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ከምትሰጡት ከስጦታችሁ ሌላ፥ ከስእለቶቻችሁም ሁሉ ሌላ፥ በፈቃዳችሁም ከምታቀርቡአቸው ሁሉ ሌላ ናቸው።
ከሰባተኛውም ወር በዐሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን የምድሩን ፍሬ ካከማቻችሁ በኋላ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን በዓል ሰባት ቀን ታደርጋላችሁ፤ የመጀመሪያዋ ቀን ዕረፍት ትሁን፤ ስምንተኛዋም ቀን ዕረፍት ትሁን።
በመጀመሪያዋ ቀን የመልካም ዛፍ ፍሬ፥ የዘንባባውንም ቅርንጫፍ፥ የለመለመውንም ዛፍ ቅርንጫፍ፥ የወንዝም አኻያ ዛፍ ውሰዱ፤ በአምላካችሁም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በየዓመቱ ሰባት ቀን ደስ ይበላችሁ።
በየዓመቱ በሰባተኛው ወር ይህን በዓል ታደርጉ ዘንድ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የዘለዓለም ሕግ ይሁንላችሁ።
ሰባት ቀን በዳሶች ውስጥ ትቀመጣላችሁ፤

"When I brought forth the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt, I commanded that your sons should be kept in the house, that all the children of the land who are in Israel should dwell in the house; for I am the Lord your God."
"And Moses spoke of all the feasts of the Lord unto the children of Israel."

sections.title: Concerning the steadfast love.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
"Let the lamps be continually burning; for the good oil, which is pure and pressed from olives, shall be brought unto thee, that thou mayest command the children of Israel."
Aaron and his sons shall keep the lamps burning from evening until morning before the Lord, it shall be a statute forever for your generations.
Before the Lord, upon the pure altar, let the lamps be kept burning continually until the morning.

sections.title: Concerning the face of the earth.

verses.text: "Take fine flour of wheat, and you shall bring it in two tenths for each offering; in each tenth, let there be two hands of the measure of ten."
"And these six shall you prepare in two portions, and before the Lord, upon a clean table, shall you set them."
"You shall make pure frankincense and salt for both; and these things shall be for a memorial before the Lord for the prepared offerings."
"Before the Lord, at all times, on every Sabbath day, you shall perform this; for it is an everlasting covenant for the children of Israel."
"For Aaron and his sons, it shall be; for the offering made by fire unto the Lord is an everlasting ordinance, and it is holy of holies, and they shall eat it in a holy place."

sections.title: Concerning the wrath that shall be poured out upon the Lord.

verses.text: And the father of the daughter of the Israelite woman was an Egyptian; and she went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a certain Israelite man were quarreling in the camp.

And the daughter of the Israelite woman named the name of the Lord and blasphemed; and they brought her to Moses. And her mother was of the tribe of Dan, the daughter of Dabere; and her name was Shelomith.
And they dwelt in confinement until the word of the Lord should declare their judgment.
And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
“Bring the blasphemer outside the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands upon his head; and let all the congregation stone him.”
Thus you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, “If any man blasphemes his God, he shall bear his sin.”

And all who blaspheme the name of the Lord shall surely be put to death; and the congregation shall stone him; whether he be a stranger or a native of the land, if he blasphemes the name of the Lord, he shall be put to death.
Whoever kills a man shall surely be put to death.
And if an animal kills a man, the animal shall be put to death, and its life shall be required.
And if a man injures his neighbor, as he has done, so shall it be done to him.
ስብራት በስብራት ፋንታ፥ ዐይን በዐይን ፋንታ፥ ጥርስ በጥርስ ፋንታ፥ ሰውን እንደ ጎዳ እንዲሁ ይደረግበት።
ሰውንም የመታና የገደለ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።
እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝና ለመጻተኛና ለሀገር ልጅ አንድ ዐይነት ሕግ ይሁንላችሁ።”
ሙሴም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገራቸው፤ ተሳዳቢውንም ከሰፈር ወደ ውጭ አወጡት፤ በድንጋይም ወገሩት። የእስራኤልም ልጆች እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው አደረጉ።

sections.title: Concerning the Sabbath year of rest.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses on Mount Sinai, saying:
"Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel: When ye come into the land which I give unto you, the land shall keep a Sabbath unto the Lord."
Six years thou shalt sow thy field; and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruits thereof.
But in the seventh year shall be a Sabbath of rest unto the land, a Sabbath for the Lord; thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
Thou shalt not oppress the hire of thy neighbor, nor the widow's garment; for it shall be a year of rest for the land.
And the Sabbath of the land shall be for thee, for thy male servant, and for thy female servant, and for thy hired servant, and for the stranger that sojourneth with thee.
And for thy cattle, and for the beasts that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

sections.title: The days of Job.

verses.text: "You shall count for yourself seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and the days of the seven Sabbaths of years shall be forty-nine years."
"Then you shall cause the trumpet of the jubilee to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the Day of Atonement you shall make the trumpet to sound throughout all your land."

"And you shall consecrate the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land to all its inhabitants; it shall be a jubilee for you; and each of you shall return to his possession, and each of you shall return to his family."
"That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee for you; in it you shall not sow, nor reap what grows of itself, nor gather the grapes of your untended vine."
"For it is the jubilee; it shall be holy to you; you shall eat the produce of your field."
"In this jubilee year, each of you shall return to his possession."
"And if you sell anything to your neighbor or buy from your neighbor's hand, you shall not oppress one another."
"According to the number of years after the jubilee, you shall buy from your neighbor; and according to the number of years of crops, he shall sell to you."
"The more numerous the years, the more you shall increase its price; and the fewer the years, the lesser shall be its price; for he sells to you according to the number of the crops."
"I am the Lord your God; you shall not oppress one another; but you shall fear your God, for I am the Lord your God."
"You shall observe My statutes, and keep My judgments, and do them; and you shall dwell in the land securely."
"The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill; and you shall dwell in it securely."
"And if you shall say, 'What shall we eat in the seventh year, if we do not sow, nor gather in our produce?'"
"Then I will command My blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years."
"And you shall sow in the eighth year, and eat of the old store until the ninth year; until her fruits come in, you shall eat of the old store."

sections.title: The Year of Jubilee.

verses.text: "The earth is mine, and you are but strangers and sojourners before me; therefore, do not sell the land forever, for it is mine."
"And concerning your possession, you shall make a redemption for the land of your inheritance."
"And if your brother becomes impoverished and sells some of his possession, then his nearest relative shall come and redeem what his brother has sold."
"If a man has no one to redeem it, but he himself becomes able to redeem it, then he shall count the years since its sale and return the remainder to the man to whom he sold it."
"The time of the sale shall return to the man, and he shall return to his possession."
"If he is unable to pay what is due, the sale shall remain in the hand of the buyer until the year of jubilee; in the jubilee year, it shall be released, and he shall return to his possession."
"If a man sells a dwelling in a walled city, he may redeem it within a year after its sale; for a full year he may redeem it."

"But if it is not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall belong to the buyer throughout his generations; it shall not be released in the jubilee year."
"However, the houses of villages which have no wall around them shall be counted as the fields of the country; they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the jubilee year."
"As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites shall have the right to redeem the houses in the cities of their possession forever."

If any man should purchase a house from the Levites, it shall be returned in the Jubilee year, for the houses of the Levites are their inheritance among the children of Israel, and a house that is sold without a city of refuge shall return in the Jubilee year.
And their fields that are around their cities are an everlasting inheritance, and they shall not be sold.

sections.title: For the poor, there is no refuge in birth.

verses.text: "If your brother is struck by you, and his hand is laid upon you, you shall assist him as a stranger and as a sojourner; let him dwell with you."
"Let your brother dwell with you, and take not from him any offspring or profit; but fear your God, for I am the Lord your God."
"Do not oppress the poor, nor give your bread to the rich."
"I will give you the land of Canaan, and I will bring you out of the land of Egypt; I am the Lord your God."

sections.title: Concerning the freedom of the servant.

verses.text: "If your brother is in distress and he sells himself to you, you shall not make him serve as a slave."
"Whether he is a hired servant or a sojourner with you, he shall serve you until the year of Jubilee."
"In the year of Jubilee, he shall go out with his children; and he shall return to his own family and to the possession of his fathers."
"For they are My servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; they shall not be sold as slaves."
"You shall not rule over him with rigor, but you shall fear your God."
"If you desire male or female servants, you may buy them from the nations around you; and from the children of the strangers who dwell among you, you may buy male and female servants."
"And you may buy the children of the strangers who dwell among you, and they shall be your possession; and they shall be to you as a heritage for your children."
"And you shall pass them on to your children after you, to inherit them as a possession forever; but over your brethren, the children of Israel, you shall not rule one over another with rigor."
"If a sojourner or a hired servant lives with you, and he becomes poor and sells himself to you, or if he sells himself to a sojourner or to a stranger's family,"
"After he is sold, he may be redeemed; one of his brothers may redeem him."
Or his uncle, or the son of his uncle, shall redeem him; or if there be any that is near of kin unto him, he may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

From the year that he was sold unto him, until the year of jubilee shall he count; his redemption money shall be according to the number of years, according to the time of a hired servant shall it be with him.
And if there be yet many years behind, according to them he shall return the price of his redemption out of the money that he was sold for.

If there remain but a few years until the year of jubilee, then he shall count with him according unto his years; and according to the time of a hired servant shall he return the price of his redemption.
In proportion to the number of years shall he be with him; as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and he shall not rule with rigor over him in thy sight.
And if he be not redeemed in those years, then he shall go out in the year of jubilee, he and his children with him.
For the children of Israel are servants unto me; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

sections.title: A blessing that is found in humility.

verses.text: "You shall not make for yourselves a carved image, nor a likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or on the earth beneath, or in the water under the earth; you shall not bow down to them or serve them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God."
"Keep My Sabbaths, and revere My sanctuary; I am the Lord your God."
"If you walk in My statutes, and keep My commandments, and perform them,"
"I will send you rain in its season, and the land shall yield its produce, and the trees of the field shall bear their fruit."
"The threshing floor shall be filled with grain, and the vats shall overflow with new wine and oil; and you shall eat and be satisfied, and dwell securely in your land."
"I will grant peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid; and I will remove harmful beasts from the land, and no sword shall go through your land."
"You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword."
"Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight; your enemies shall fall before you by the sword."
"I will look upon you favorably and make you fruitful, multiply you, and confirm My covenant with you."
"You shall eat the old harvest, and clear out the old because of the new."
I will make my dwelling among you; and my soul shall not abhor you.
I will dwell among you; I am the Lord your God, and you shall be my people.
I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage; I have broken the yoke of your burden and made you walk upright.

sections.title: The punishment that cometh upon the unyielding.

verses.text: "However, if you do not listen to me, and if you do not carry out all these commandments,

if you despise my statutes, and if you do not observe all my commandments, and if you break my covenant, then I will bring upon you the terror, the wasting disease, and the fever that consumes the eyes and causes sorrow in the heart; and you shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it."
"I will set my face against you; and you shall be defeated by your enemies; those who hate you shall reign over you; and you shall flee when no one pursues you."
"And if, in spite of this, you do not listen to me, I will increase your punishment sevenfold for your sins."
"I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heavens like iron and your earth like bronze."
"And your strength shall be spent in vain; for your land shall not yield its produce, nor shall the trees of the land yield their fruit."
"Then, if you walk contrary to me and will not listen to me, I will bring upon you a sword that shall execute vengeance for the covenant; and you shall be gathered together within your cities."

"And if you do not listen to me, I will bring upon you the wild beasts of the field, which shall rob you of your children; and destroy your livestock; and make you few in number; and your roads shall be desolate."
"And if, in spite of these things, you do not turn to me, but walk contrary to me,"
"then I will also walk contrary to you in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins."
I, indeed, will go forth in wrath; for your iniquities, I will strike you sevenfold.
I will bring upon you a sword to execute the word of my covenant; and you shall flee to your cities; I will send pestilence among you.
When you are besieged by hunger, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven; and they shall deliver your bread again by weight; and you shall eat, but not be satisfied.
Until this time, if you will not hearken unto me, I will go forth in wrath against you.
I, indeed, will go forth in wrath; and for your iniquities, I will punish you sevenfold.
You shall eat the flesh of your sons; and you shall eat the flesh of your daughters.
I will destroy your high places; and I will cut down your images, and cast your carcasses upon the carcasses of your idols; and my soul shall abhor you.
I will make your cities waste; and I will bring your sanctuaries to desolation; and I will not smell the savor of your sweet odors.
I will make the land desolate; and your enemies who dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
I will bring you to ruin among the nations; and in the places where you shall flee, the sword shall overtake you; and your land shall be desolate; and your cities shall be waste.
"And in that time, when you are in the land of your enemies, the land shall rejoice in making its Sabbath; and at that time the land shall rest; it shall rejoice in making its Sabbath."
"You were not forsaken while you dwelt in your Sabbaths, for in the time of your enemies, it shall rest."
"Even in the lands of your enemies, I shall strike their hearts with a stone, as they are separated from you; and the sound of the wind shall terrify them, as they flee from the sword."
"None shall pursue them, and they shall be terrified, each one of them turning upon their neighbor; and you shall not be able to stand before your enemies."
"Among the nations, you shall perish; and the land of your enemies shall devour you."
"And those who remain separated from you shall perish because of their iniquities; and their fathers' iniquities shall also be upon the land of their enemies."
"As I have been forsaken, so they shall be forsaken before me; they shall bear their iniquities and the iniquities of their fathers."

"I too have been angry and have gone with them to destruction; I shall destroy their land of enemies. Nevertheless, at that time, their unrepentant hearts shall tremble; for their iniquities, they shall bear."
"At that time, I shall remember the covenant I made with Jacob; likewise, the covenant I made with Isaac, and the covenant I made with Abraham; I shall remember the land."

"The land shall be desolate because of them; it shall remain barren, and in the time of their enemies, it shall observe rest; and because of their iniquities, their souls shall bear the punishment of their sins."

Yet I am the Lord their God, and as they dwell in the land of their adversaries, I will not forsake them until I have brought them to an end, nor will I break my covenant with them; I will not be unmindful of them.
I will be their God, and I have remembered my covenant with them, as they have seen my deliverance from the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage; for I am the Lord.
And the Lord gave commandments and judgments to the children of Israel through Moses on Mount Sinai; these are the statutes and ordinances.

sections.title: Concerning the offering presented unto the Lord, a law was given.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
"Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel: If any man shall make a vow concerning the value of his soul unto the Lord, according to thy estimation, so shall the valuation be for his body."
"From twenty years old and upward, even unto sixty years old, shall thy valuation be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary."
"And if it be a female, then thy valuation shall be thirty shekels."
"And from five years old and upward, even unto twenty years old, thy valuation for a male shall be twenty shekels, and for a female, ten shekels."
"And from one month old even unto five years old, thy valuation for a male shall be five shekels of silver, and for a female, thy valuation shall be three shekels of silver."
"And from sixty years old and upward, if it be a male, then thy valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female, ten shekels."

"But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that the hand of the priest shall find, so shall the priest value him."
"And if it be an animal that men may bring as an offering unto the Lord, all that any man giveth of such unto the Lord shall be holy."
"The good shall not be exchanged for the bad, nor the bad for the good; and if the animal be changed for an animal, then both it and the exchange shall be holy."
The beast shall not be an abomination unto the Lord, even if it be unclean; let it be set before the priest.
Whether it be good or evil, let the priest judge; and according to the judgment of the priest, so shall it be.
If it be a thing to be redeemed, let the fifth part be added above the valuation.
"If a man shall sanctify his house unto the Lord, the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or evil; and according to the estimation of the priest, so shall it stand."
"If a man shall redeem his house, let the fifth part be added above the valuation; and the house shall be his."
"If a man shall sow his field unto the Lord, let the estimation be according to its sowing; a field that is sown with barley shall be estimated at fifty shekels of silver."
And if he shall sow his field from the year of Jubilee, let it stand according to the estimation.
And if he shall sow his field after the year of Jubilee, the priest shall reckon unto him according to the years that remain unto the year of Jubilee; and it shall be reduced from the valuation.
If a man shall redeem his field, let the fifth part be added above the valuation; and it shall be his.
If he shall not redeem his field, or if he shall sell it to another man, it shall not be redeemed again.
The field, however, shall be a holy field unto the Lord in the year of Jubilee; and the inheritance shall belong to the priest.
If a man shall sell his own field that is not of the inheritance unto the Lord,
the priest shall reckon the value of the sale until the year of Jubilee; and in that day, he shall return the valuation as a holy thing unto the Lord.
In the year of Jubilee, the field shall return to its owner, to him to whom it belonged, for it is his own land.
And all valuations shall be as the sanctuary's shekel; twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
"Every firstling of your livestock that is born shall be holy unto the Lord; no man shall change it, whether it be an ox or a sheep, it is holy unto the Lord.
And if it be a blemished beast, it shall be valued according to the valuation; and he shall add a fifth part thereof to it; but if it be unvalued, it shall be sold according to the valuation.

"And every devoted thing that a man shall devote unto the Lord, whether of man or beast, or of the field of his possession, shall not be sold or redeemed; every devoted thing is most holy unto the Lord.
And if it be of men, that which is devoted shall not be redeemed until he is dead.
"And the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the tree, is the Lord's; it is holy unto the Lord."

ከበሬም ሁሉ ከዐሥር አንድ፥ ከበግም ሁሉ ከዐሥር አንድ፥ ከእረኛውም በትር በታች ከሚያልፍ ሁሉ ከዐሥር አንድ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ይሆናል።
መልካሙን በክፉ፥ ክፉውንም በመልካም አይለውጥ፤ ቢለውጠውም እርሱና ልዋጩ የተቀደሱ ይሆናሉ፤ አይቤዠውም።”
